param: Λ Recruitment rate into the susceptible population (newborns).
μ Natural death rate for all compartments.
w Vaccination rate for susceptible individuals.
ε Rate of vaccine waning, causing vaccinated individuals to become susceptible again.
β Transmission rate for primary infection of susceptible individuals.
γ Recovery rate for infected individuals.
σ Reinfection factor, modifying the transmission rate for recovered individuals.
β_reinfection Effective transmission rate for reinfection of recovered individuals.
